title: Output of the scenario-scene agent: the plans of ONE scene

plans.description: The scene's plans, in reading order. Order is that of the array: no plan number.

titre.description: (French) Distinct from every other plan's title.

description.description: (French) What happens and why the plan exists, then the lines said (each `NAME : « exact text »`, in the dialogue language, before « État en fin de plan : »). Narrative, with no framing, light, sound or camera movement, and no reference to another plan.

liaison.description: How this plan links to the PREVIOUS one (for the first plan: to the previous scene's last plan). suite: it takes up where the previous plan ends (same place, same moment or seconds later, same people where the previous « État en fin de plan » left them). coupe: a clean cut (another place, another moment, another point of view). The first plan of the episode is a coupe. When unsure: coupe.

dureeSecondes.description: Generation duration, whole seconds, from 5 to 10 (never less than 5). It follows the brief's rhythm and the scene's genre; group close moments into a single plan. A dialogue plan: generous duration, breathing margin of at least 2 s.

inventions.description: (French) Everything that was not in the brief nor the treatment. To validate or throw out.

notes.description: (French) Risky plans, a dialogue too long for the scene. Empty if nothing to report.
